content.title: Who Is Galaxy Girl on ‘Masked Singer’? Vegas Clue Sparks New Guesses
content.text: Skip to main contentWho is Galaxy Girl on ‘Masked Singer’? A Las Vegas clue has the panel guessing Hilary Duff, Avril Lavigne and Taylor Momsen.Mar 18, 2026 8:27 PM EDTGalaxy Girl on ‘The Masked Singer’ season 14. Trae Patton/FOXKey PointsGalaxy Girl performed Ellie Goulding’s “Lights,” impressing Masked Singer panel with strong vocals.Key clues include a Las Vegas work connection, husband who gambles, not Gwen Stefani.Panel guesses ranged from Taylor Momsen to Avril Lavigne and Hilary Duff. Galaxy Girl lit up the stage once again Star Trek night on The Masked Singer season 14. Performing Ellie Goulding’s “Lights,” she delivered a polished, emotional performance that reinforced the idea she’s a seasoned entertainer. Related: Meet the Cast Competing on ‘The Masked Singer’ Season 14 Galaxy Girl showcased strong vocals and confidence with “Lights,” continuing to impress the panel. But her biggest hint came from a clue tied to Las Vegas. “My husband may love his slot machines, but when I go to Vegas, I’m not there to gamble. I’m there to work,” the singer said. Related: ‘Masked Singer’ Panel’s Dream Cast Includes a Few Truly Wild Ideas (Exclusive) 🔍 New Clues This Week Las Vegas connection A husband who enjoys gambling Colossal Clue: showgirls Confirmation she is not Gwen Stefani Related: ‘Masked Singer’ Panel Reveals Favorite Performers of All Time—and the Answers Might Surprise You (Exclusive) 🎤 What the Panel Is Saying Robin Thicke guessed Taylor Momsen, saying, “She played the little girl in the Grinch years ago, so I’m going to guess Taylor Momsen.” Rita Ora leaned toward another female rocker saying, “I keep feeling an Avril Lavigne type energy.” Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg suggested Hilary Duff, saying, “She has a song called ‘This is What Dreams Are Made Of’…could this be Hilary Duff?” Related: ‘Masked Singer’ Reveals First-Ever Twist That Changes the Game for Season 14 🕯 Previous Clues So Far Earlier clues pointed to a performer with both acting and music success. Hints included holiday imagery, references to childhood fame and major pop success, suggesting someone who transitioned from early stardom into a long-lasting career.
